主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported its financial results for the three months ended December 31, 2016. Diluted earnings per share decreased by 40% to $0.21, compared to $0.35 for the same period in 2015. Net earnings were $1.6 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2016, down from $2.7 million in the same period of 2015. Revenue declined 3% to $22.0 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2016, compared to $22.8 million in the prior-year period. The results reflect the company's performance in its financial services operations during the quarter. The report was filed with the SEC on February 2, 2017, and includes a press release dated the same date. The company's management, including Ralph T. Finkenbrink and Katie L. MacGillivary, signed the report as required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
